The question is that amendments on sheet 3824 be agreed to. _Australian Greens_ _'__circulated amendments—_ (1) Schedule 1, page 21 (after line 25), after Part 9, insert: Part 9A — Certain mandatory terms of workplace determinations must not be less favourable _Fair Work Act 2009_ 58A Section 270A (heading) Repeal the heading, substitute: 270A Certain terms must not be less favourable 58B After subsection 270A(2) Insert: (2A) A term that is included in the determination to comply with subsection 273(2), (4), (5) or (6) must be not less favourable to each of those employees, and any employee organisation that was a bargaining representative of any of those employees, than a term of the enterprise agreement that deals with the same matter as the term included in the determination.
